changesets.summary: Add a subtle About LDForge icon to the editor footer with copyright, MIT license, GitHub, documentation and release-note links with matching icons, a miniature LDForge logo linking to the project website and an aligned copyright row at the bottom. The accessible popover supports outside-click and Escape dismissal. Hide it with controls.about: false.
Rebuild the standalone Yasgui browser bundle with @ldforge/editor@1.4.0.
